text: とび　おりるのは　ちょっと　こわいけど…　マサラ　タウンに　かえる　ときは　はやく　かえれて　いいよ

structure.jp: ちょっと　こわいけど…
マサラ　タウンに　かえる　ときは
structure.en: when you go back to Pallet Town

structure.jp: はやく　かえれて　いいよ
structure.en: it's nice that you can get back quickly

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. とび おりるのは = 'jumping down (is...)'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かえる to かえれる makes it 'can go back'; the て-form then gives the reason for the good feeling that follows. はやく かえれて いい = 'it's nice because you can get back quickly'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two statements with 'but'. こわいけど = 'it's scary, but...'
